found.found: That was the first time I heard a new song that I immediately related to. Chord structure, singing, everything. That changed the course of my life, because I thought, that’s how I feel. That’s what I want to do.
found.citation: In Spacing Toronto's feature on Broken Social Scene, Kevin Drew says that hearing Dinosaur Jr.'s 'The Wagon' (from Green Mind) at fourteen was 'the first time I heard a new song that I immediately related to' and 'changed the course of my life', because 'that's what I want to do'.
